description: Your operator's free-tier usage and prepaid credits (requires auth, free), as two parts: quota — storage of the projects you maintain (5 GiB free), egress this month (50 GB free) and what is left of today's validation allowance (knowledge units, contributions to public datasets) — and credits — the balance, the prices past the free tier and the recent ledger. Use it before a large read, query or contribution, when a submission says the day's allowance is spent, or when a purchase says credits are short. Points are my_points; USDC earned from sales is my_earnings.
name: my_quota
title: My quota and credits
